convert_legacy_predictions: run the script to convert legacy NeuralDB prediction JSONL files to a new instance format
transform_predictions: transform raw prediction tuples into structured JSON instances with prediction, actual, and metadata fields
extract_metadata: extract database size and query type metadata from legacy prediction files
split_list_predictions: split predicted and actual values on the [LIST] delimiter into separate items
calculate_dbsize: calculate the unique database size by reducing and deduplicating gold facts from query metadata
